Health tips

Hygiene

Wash your hands

Wash with soap and clean water after the toilet and before eating or preparing food.

Children

Keep immunisation on schedule

Take your child for every dose and keep the child health card safe.

Adults

Check your blood pressure

Have your blood pressure and blood sugar checked regularly.

Water

Drink safe water

Boil or treat drinking water and store it in a clean, covered container.

Common questions

What time does the hospital open?

The out-patient clinic runs Monday to Saturday, 08:00 to 17:00. Casualty is open every day, 24 hours.

How do I register as a new patient?

Fill in the registration form on this site. You receive a reference number to show at reception, so you skip the long form at the desk.

Does it cost anything to be seen?

Consultation at this public hospital is free. Ask at reception if you are told to buy anything.

When is the next vaccination day?

See the News & Health Tips page. Routine child immunisation runs every Monday and Thursday. Bring the child health card.

How soon will I get an answer?

Questions are answered within two working days. The reply appears under My requests, with your reference number.

Give feedback

Tell us what worked and what did not. It goes to the hospital management.
